messages:
anna: :rotating_light: incident-bot just fired PagerDuty (P12345) for inference-cell-7. Symptoms: queue depth spike, autoscaler not adding nodes. I'm on pager.
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired: in-flight-queue-surge (P12345). Trigger: queue_depth > 5000 sustained 2m. Affected: hosted text-generation / embeddings routes. Links: https://pd.example/P12345
ops-bot: auto-diagnostics attached: cluster_provision_errors=47 (5m), node_provision_latency=avg 3.4m, recent failure msg: "allocation handshake timeout" from kube-provisioner. Suggest checking provider spot fallback.
ryan: acked. Jumping in — looking at autoscaler controller logs now. Could be warm-pool exhaustion + spot preemptions.
devon: I see a spike in spot preemptions in the last 10m for the region eu-west-1, plus fleet quotas hitting soft limit. Warm pool size was 0 for this cell.
pat: Confirming logs for the scale job:
```
[2026-03-17T16:02:12Z] scaler: request nodes=8, requested_pool=spot
[2026-03-17T16:04:48Z] kube-provisioner: allocate failed: PreemptionLimitExceeded
[2026-03-17T16:06:01Z] scaler: retrying, backoff 30s
```
ryan: Trying manual scale to on-demand to break the stall. I will start a rapid warm-up of 4 on-demand nodes to the inference pool. If that works we can drain queue and then try reverting to spot.
anna: Do it. Customer impact? Any 5xx spikes?
slo-bot: SLO alert: embedding_success_rate dropped from 99.98% -> 97.3% over last 10m. 502 and 504 spike correlated with queue depth. Top impacted customers: 3 mid-market tenants with heavy batch embedding jobs.
devon: Noting this is causing increased latency but not data loss. Recommend manual on-demand spin + increase warm_pool_min to 6 after stabilizing.
pat: Running command to scale pool (manual):
```
kubectl -n infra scale deployment/inference-warm-pool --replicas=6
provider-api request: flavor=on-demand count=4 region=eu-west-1
```
pat: provider responded: allocation accepted, instances provisioning (ids: i-0a1b2c3d...). ETA ~2m.
ryan: Seeing nodeReady events coming in. kubelet registration lag ~45s per node. Starting to drain backlog processors onto new capacity.
anna: Good. How fast is queue dropping?
ops-bot: queue_depth: 5400 -> 3200 (3m), request_latency_p50 embeddings: 420ms -> 210ms. Errors 502 count: 84 -> 22 (since nodes registered).
devon: Keep an eye on autoscaler — it retried spot allocation and may have queued further requests that conflict with manual on-demand. I'll patch the scaler policy to prefer on-demand for the next 30m.
ryan: Patched autoscaler flag: `prefer_on_demand=true` for inference-cell-7, TTL 30m. Monitoring.
anna: I'll update PD with mitigation note and ETA to clear.
anna: PD update (manual): "Investigating queue backlog caused by spot preemptions and warm-pool exhaustion. Manually provisioning on-demand nodes; mitigation in progress. No customer data loss. Impact: elevated latency and transient 5xx for some customers. Next update in 10m or on stabilization"
incident-bot: PagerDuty P12345 updated: status=acknowledged, note added.
ryan: Queue depth now 3200 -> 900 (6m after scale). Error rate trending down.
pat: Starting cleanup: will leave warm pool at 6 for 45m, then evaluate.
slo-bot: SLO recovery: embedding_success_rate back to 99.1% (last 5m).
anna: OK handoff plan — I'll stay until stable for another 15m then hand to night rotation. If anything flares, page P12345 and escalate to infra-sre.
devon: Follow up todo: add a warm-pool health check to detect 0-size and auto-fill, and add provider-quota alert. Filing ticket INFRA-2142.
ryan: Thanks all. Marking incident de-escalation in channel; leaving a short postmortem note in incidents/ shortly.
anna: closing updates for now. :thumbsup:
